notes.title: Breaking Gates Update and Improvements for Version 1.2
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, little guy who lives right over there! We're back with fresh news! Development continues steadily and full of energy, and today we bring you another update for you to try out in early access.
[/p][p]This is another step towards the final version, and we really want to hear your feedback. Every comment, every gameplay, and every livestream you do helps us improve the game even further. You're an essential part of this journey, and it's thanks to your support that we keep moving forward.
[/p][p]Before we show you what's coming next, we'd like to say thank you ❤️
[/p][h1]Trading materials 
[/h1][p]A new NPC is now available on the map! Meet [b]Bico, the traveling merchant[/b]! A wanderer from distant desert lands who, from time to time, appears bringing materials to trade.
[/p][p]With him, the logic is simple: direct exchange, one item for another. Just choose the most interesting trade, and that's it! The shop's stock will replenish whenever you die or return to camp, bringing new opportunities.
[/p][p]Besides selling [b]emblems[/b], Bico also offers [b]exclusive materials[/b], essential for forging certain equipment.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/4d46bc5b94883ad2177d7f857c6d4cabd9ca82b5.gif"][/img][/p][h1] [/h1][h1]New Equipment[/h1][p][/p][p]Three new swords and one new accessory have been added to the game. Two of the swords will be crafted at [b]Helga's[/b] forge from previously unused materials.[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Return Blade[/b]: This sword can be found in common chests or by defeating enemies. It allows you to perform a mid-range attack by throwing the sword.[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Jaw Blade[/b]: A sword that fires a barrage of sharp teeth at enemies. It's crafted from materials found among the game's aquatic enemies, such as [b]piranhas and electric fish[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]King of the Deep[/b]: This sword emits a wave of lightning that paralyzes surrounding enemies. It can also be forged at the camp and requires materials from the game's aquatic enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Equivalent Exchange[/b]: A ring that can be crafted at Helga's forge using only materials exchanged with the NPC Beak. It can double your damage, but you take more damage from enemies. [/p][p]      [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/fb01105460702c46b73dc48bbd540811c1e2f3eb.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/4e38b8015c5cd2cda01eceac41ce7f187e626b6e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Adjustments and Improvements[/h1][list][*][p][b]Equipment and Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where the passive skill [b]"Safety First"[/b] at max level of the [b]Gas Mask helmet[/b], caused damage to the player when being poisoned.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified some basic attributes of certain equipment to improve game balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where bees summoned by the Royal Buzzer sword's [b]"Avenging Swarm"[/b] ability would have incorrect textures and remain alive after loading a save.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the [b]Vinesword's Forest Absorption skill[/b] so it now properly heals for the correct percentage of the gear's upgrade level.[/p][/*][*][p]Two new consumable items have been added to common chests and breakable items. They have a higher chance of appearing on the [b]Allira Forest map[/b]. [b]River Grapes[/b] heal some of your HP. [b]Blue Mist Fruit[/b] increases your SP by +15.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/9b7fa890ddfa5d8652d49ee44e86c7f2c5bcb65c.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Translations[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed item description text that was missing translations.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some terms and phrases with attack and skill names.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Exploration[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjustments to the oxygen bar in the underwater sections, giving the player a little more time to breathe.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to some sections and the addition of another fast travel portal to the [b]Allira Forest map[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fight[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changes to the  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/2859e85ffd1774a9116bd5b975bae10827a7474e.png"][/img]  [b]Regeneration[/b] attribute[b]:[/b][/p][p]Previously: This attribute only increased the effectiveness of healing items and abilities, providing a percentage bonus based on the Regeneration value.[/p][p]Now: Regeneration works differently. Whenever you take damage, after a few seconds without being hit, your health will gradually begin to recover. The higher the Regeneration value, the faster and more efficient this process will be.

You can only increase the Regeneration attribute by equipping emblems on your gear.
 [/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to change the direction of strong attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Added attack canceling when jumping or dashing.[/p][/*][*][p]The activation animation speed of sword special attacks has been increased, making them more agile.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed situation where the [b]Electric Fish[/b] enemy would get stuck on the edge of the screen in the crystal fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the enemy [b]Strong Panpaku[/b]'s special attack where it would occasionally hitkill the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed situation where bees would stop following the player right after he got out of the water[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to deflect boss Allira's energy spheres with your attack.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Menus and interface[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the inventory menu could be opened within the cutscene after completing the [b]Ancient Gates challenge[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed situation where the gallery button did not open.[/p][/*][*][p]Added button to organize items by category in inventory and item chest.[/p][/*][*][p]Added button to quickly deposit all items into the chest.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/f3f897665430bfe9936009480a2b630d0a9fc1e4.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Items and fabrications[/b][/p][list][*][p]SP potions now only appear in Juan's shop after purchasing a special skill.[/p][/*][*][p]All healing items have now been scaled by percentage, receiving a significant increase in their effectiveness.[/p][/*][*][p]All crafting manuals and hunt rewards have been adjusted to improve balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where it was not possible to select the concentrated blue potion in Juan's potion shop.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Various minor fixes and additional tweaks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][/p][h1]Final Considerations[/h1][p][/p][p]Well, I think that's it. We'll be analyzing more things throughout the week and perhaps making some more adjustments. We're still planning more mechanics for equipment and items, as well as several improvements and new content.
[/p][p]It's a difficult game to balance, but remember that we're not alone. We have the support of all the players and also of our beloved publisher, who, in addition to providing publishing support, helps us with tips and support in various areas of development.
[/p][p]This is another step towards the final version! Keep sending us feedback, because every suggestion helps make the game even better. Thank you so much for being part of this journey with us, and see you in the next update![/p]

notes.title: Breaking Gates Update 1.2 Preview
notes.content:
[p]Hello adventurer reader!

It's been a while since we last talked, but I'm still here, going strong and steadily developing. Today, I’m excited to announce a new update coming to Early Access! Actually, this is a preview of Update 1.2, which we’re planning to launch at the end of the year. Since we’re still in Early Access, it makes more sense to release new features gradually and gather feedback from players before the final version.

So feel free to jump in and enjoy! Before we dive into the news, I want to extend a massive thank you to each one of you. The journey of Breaking Gates is driven by the passion and dedication of our community. It's inspiring to see you all playing, creating content, and streaming! This support has been fundamental in guiding the development. And of course, a special thanks to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/nuntiusgames"]Nuntius[/url], our publisher, who made this comeback and update possible.

Alright, let’s not take up too much of your time — let’s check out the changes!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248550/Breaking_Gates/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][h1]A New Perspective! New Character Illustrations![/h1][p]

Our amazing illustrator [url="https://www.instagram.com/vieira.arte_"]Pedro Vieira[/url] brought the idea of modernizing the characters' visuals to give the game a more commercial and updated look. Since we’re bringing the game to more platforms and reaching a wider audience, it made sense to me. So in addition to new illustrations and promotional art, he also redesigned all the dialogue images, giving the game a much more professional feel. Here's a preview of our protagonist:

[/p][h3]Character Art – Hako[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/61821e42050f7a979849d2dbaf114ca9aede13cc.png"][/img][/p][h3]Character Art for Dialogue Scenes[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/728de499ecc494bc62fc5028223cb418f9ccc9bc.gif"][/img][/p][h2]New Gallery Menu[/h2][p]You can now view all these new illustrations in the registry menu under the character information section.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/4c6eb5e125a1fc9002cd7429118e20b17472ef9b.gif"][/img][/p][h2]
The New Adventure Log![/h2][p] We now have an Adventure Log menu! A place with background info on characters and details about enemies. As you play, new entries will appear in the log. Our plan is to expand the Adventure Log with item information, universe trivia, and much more — turning it into a sort of in-game guide.  Of course, I’m not sure if everything will be possible, but this is a solid start! Even if it doesn’t affect gameplay directly, I think it’s fun to have this kind of writing. Oh, and we’ve tied some new achievements to it too, for those who take a peek. 
    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/0bb8cc47821bad3cd395793d47b560a002a04ccf.png"][/img][/p][h1]
A Visual Polish![/h1][p]
One of the changes in version 1.2 was the remastering of all textures to better fit larger screens. While Breaking Gates has a charming style, we hadn’t anticipated the need for this adjustment. Nowadays, modern consoles support much higher resolutions, and our little game didn’t scale well, looking blurry on big screens. Here’s how the game looked on a 4K display:
[/p][h3]Before[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/2349503dd150851d5a4fb82b650e15054eb9597e.png"][/img]
It was clear that it wasn’t working — the character looked huge, the UI was oversized. The game was originally made for small screens and mobile devices (I can’t deny my roots… it was what I could do at the time on my tiny Samsung A10 with 2GB of RAM!).[/p][h3]
After[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/2cd3a157aa3dc8e49b1c2298a530d09dd8ef6293.png"][/img]
After some research, we found out that for a game to look good on large screens, it needs to have around one million pixels — and ours had less than seven hundred thousand. So we took a step back before adding new content and worked on remastering all textures for better clarity. There's still work to do, and some menus are still being adjusted. Not all textures adapted well, so we had to remake and even create new ones. Many original assets were lost over time. With future updates, we’ll keep improving things. But now, the UI is cleaner, and the proportions feel more natural on modern screens.[/p][p]
[/p][h1]Combat Improvements[/h1][p]
I've always loved 2D combat games — I have so many in mind I can't even name them all! I used to have this design philosophy: “If you can do it to the enemy, the enemy can do it to you!” It led to some hilarious — and frustrating — moments.

Just like you could beat enemies into the corner, they could do the same to you — even kicking you while you were knocked down! That, my friends… is life! Anyway, despite criticism, I still consider that part of the game’s essence.

That said, we toned it down a bit. We’ve added a new enemy damage control system that tries to “save” you when possible. It works smartly, monitoring your HP and gradually scaling down enemy damage. This idea is borrowed from a fighting game mechanic! Of course, it won’t save you every time — some enemies have nasty moves that bypass the system… These creatures are ruthless and seem to have a mind of their own!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/291f92ed4cb355b910a0cddc713a98b0ae4ad549.gif"][/img][/p][h2]
Dodge Dash with Invincibility!
[/h2][p]One thing that was missing — and has now been added — is a brief moment of invincibility during dashes. You can now truly dodge enemy attacks. I made it subtle — not too easy or too hard — but it might save you in the right moment.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/53ef731361b1cef68a222cb9cdaa2c9144659526.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Combo Counter[/h2][p]The combo counter is back! It now boosts your Super Energy — the higher your combo, the more energy you gain!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/7a5ef3dced72f68e796364a6b10df5c221a378cb.png"][/img][/p][p]

[/p][h1]New Items[/h1][p]
[/p][h3]Forge Shop[/h3][p]- Added "Royal Zumbidora Sword" to Helga’s Forge Shop – Summons bees that chase and sting nearby enemies.

Added "Wind Sword" to Helga’s Forge Shop – Creates a powerful gust of wind that launches enemies into the air.

New Helmet "Forest Ruler" in Helga’s Forge Shop – Recovers a percentage of your health when falling into an abyss.

New Helmet "Gale Helm" in Helga’s Forge Shop – If equipped with the Wind Sword, boosts its ability with bonus damage.

[/p][h3]Potion Shop[/h3][p]- New Barrier Potions added to Juan’s Potion Shop.

New SP Recovery Potions added to Juan’s Potion Shop.

[/p][h3]New Drop Items[/h3][p]- New Helmet "Stylish Glasses" – Increases skill cooldown recovery percentage.

New Sword "Panpaku Blade" – Temporarily transforms you into one of the enemies.

New Accessory "Warrior Master's Book" – Increases gained experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/5b219271a010182b21d21cc3ae7d3d1fe55aa613.png"][/img][/p][h1]Fixes and Other Adjustments[/h1][h3]Interface[/h3][p][/p][p]Added attribute descriptions in the Status Menu[/p][p][/p][p]Increased inventory space[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed crash when opening pause menu[/p][p][/p][p]Modified some terms and labels for better clarity[/p][p][/p][h3]Environment[/h3][p][/p][p]Removed abyss pits in the water section of Allira Forest[/p][p][/p][p]Added support platforms in some Allira Forest areas[/p][p][/p][p]Added activation crystals to the Ancestral Gates (Still improving this!)[/p][p][/p][p]Collision improvements and adjustments[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed items and crystals sticking to ceilings![/p][p][/p][p]Removed some enemies from certain map areas to improve level flow[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Combat[/h3][p][/p][p]Improved hitboxes on several attacks[/p][p][/p][p]"Celestial Charge" ability now keeps the player airborne[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed bug where enemies became invincible[/p][p]
More collision improvements

To be continued...[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New content coming!!!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!
Get ready, something special is coming to Breaking Gates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248550/Breaking_Gates

[h1]What happened?[/h1]
We know it's been a while since the last update, since version 1.1 the game has gone through several difficulties. We are a small team of independent developers from Brazil, and everything is extremely difficult for us.

But thanks to the emergence of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/nuntiusgames][b]Nuntius Games[/b][/url], a Brazilian publisher that believed in our project, we can finally share that the development of Breaking Gates is back, now to finish the game completely. Nuntius will not only publish the game, but has also welcomed us with supervision, content curation and development support.

It's a strong and very competent team that brings together several veterans and experts from our country. It's worth checking out all the games from this wonderful publisher! We're aware that we need to improve some aspects of our game and they're giving us all the guidance we need! Now... let me open my folder and show you a few things:

[h1]Finally, another area! Salamar Desert.[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/8fe07b9c0f868252cc98d8164281d34b4ac6bf73.gif[/img]

We had planned this desert for a while and were finalizing a lot of things, but we never managed to bring it to the game. This happened for several reasons: we lost files, our HD burned out, and we didn't have enough time to dedicate to development.

Speaking a little about this new area, the Salamar Desert will be a more hostile and desolate region with a strong storm area that will hinder the player, as well as underground areas with scalding lava to fry you if you miss a jump!

New area, new enemies, we will include some new enemies too, from lizard warriors to temperamental cacti that will throw thorns at you!

[h2]New enemies arriving:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/f804e79361c2b118b76df15c81e4c024ec71e615.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/3f6e2c6ef9e89e80db054578b109e893a8720a48.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/4640eeadbe8369cf5eb7cea472daf1677c3f70e8.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/6b08faaeb583b254081343bce40cf5911aeb7467.gif[/img]

[h2]A new guardian to face, meet Sarvok of the sharp feathers![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/fbac312126c8d2f3d18daeb92f9a16cdc16bfd2c.png[/img]

Of course, there could not be a master enemy to challenge you! This time our little recruit will have to prove his courage, facing Sarvok armed with his powerful giant feather sword! A weapon that despite its appearance can cut through even the toughest of enemies! We are in the production and final art stage and we can show you a little bit of the process:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/97c9110ba9aef8b8ac283a19744281b19fd706f6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/34ac388e9c53ebd1db732c125a9632a25ba4b117.gif[/img]

[h1]What are we doing?[/h1]

Currently, thanks to all the support from players with ideas and suggestions, in addition to the support and guidance from Nuntius, we are producing new areas, items, enemies and gameplay improvements! These changes we are making are aimed at the final release, including for the console version too! [list]
[*] New functions for inventory, warehouse and item manufacturing menus;
[*] Combat and item generation balancing;
[*] New hunting missions, new rewards and extra challenges on the map;
[*] A new batch of unique equipment with skills and bonuses for the character;
[*] Graphic improvements, resolution and texture adjustments;
[/list]

[h2]Ok, that's all very nice, but what about it? When will this new content be released?[/h2]
Well, if you're still reading this, it's because you really like the game! We have two predictions here, to be honest, October or early next year! Of course, this is an estimate, remember we're just four people and a dream! This is our first little game and we've been through a lot of problems! But if you're interested in all this, don't forget to add Breaking Gates to your wishlist and follow us on social media to stay up to date. And of course, share your thoughts with us, every piece of feedback is one more step towards making the game even better! If you can follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/nuntiusgames][b]Nuntius Games[/b][/url] and find out about other amazing games, we would be very grateful!

I want to thank everyone who has been waiting for us all this time and who has helped us with many tips and suggestions! I apologize to everyone for the delay, but I believe you understand that despite everything we are still trying! ....ok, time to get back to work... I've already written too much here and my coffee has gone cold! Stay tuned and thank you all very much!

notes.title: Update 1.1.29
notes.content:
Hi guys, =D
We'd like to express our gratitude to everyone who has supported our game and sent us amazing suggestions and ideas over time. We ask for your understanding, as our team is currently small and we don't have the resources to dedicate full time to the game. Despite the difficulties, we are committed to continuing to move forward and working to offer the best possible experience.

[h3]Functionalities[/h3]
[b]1.[/b] Cloud save system implemented.
[b]2.[/b] Slight improvements to game controls and Huds.
[b]3.[/b] There is now an indicator above the destroy equipment button showing that you regain your upgrade points by destroying equipment that has already been upgraded before.

[h3]Bug fixes and tweaks:[/h3]
[b]1.[/b] Adjustments to enemy damage and attributes.
[b]2.[/b] Improved balancing in the distribution of important items.
[b]3.[/b] Increased amount of crystals when defeating enemies.
[b]4.[/b] Enemies now have the possibility to drop epic manuals and emblems now.
[b]5.[/b] Fixed the character not being able to jump in narrower areas.
[b]6.[/b] Some translation errors have been fixed.
[b]7.[/b] Fixed a bug with the Whirl Slash skill that made the game crash at certain times >_<'.
[b]8.[/b] Fixed error when equipping some emblems on equipment.
[b]9.[/b] Minor bugs were also fixed.

[h3]New Features for Equipment[/h3]
Passive gear skills have been overhauled and updated, bringing a wide variety of new skills that benefit the player with stat bonuses or buffs to certain moves. We currently have a list (in English) of all the skills that the forum has implemented. We've also created a new accessory to craft that was missed in previous updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39057284/8d5b1a2004416adf64929a030ff3ed0c7843fb47.png[/img]


We are very grateful for all the continued support. Hope you have fun playing our game. Consider evaluating it if you haven't left any game reviews yet, and if there's a problem, let us know so we can solve it. And contact us if you have any problems or report a bug. Thank you very much ^^

notes.title: Update 1.1.21
New Camp Update ~ Avaliable!
notes.content:
[h1]Equipment system improvements[/h1]
We redid all equipment mechanics to make the game more dynamic.
[list]
[*] Added the emblems that can be placed on equipment to increase its attributes
[*] New upgrade system for equipment with Mastery Points, acquired with each level the player gains
[*] Modified Helga's Forge. Now you have to explore the map to find the strongest equipment recipes.
[*] Swords now, in addition to changing the look of the character, have special attacks.
[*] Amulets and helmets now have passive abilities that give advantages to the player.
[/list] 

[h1]Improvements to all maps[/h1]
We visually reworked the entire first Campos de Kirian map, which now has an even better level design.
You can now see where your character is on the map, and we've also reworked some parts of the game to make it more fun to explore.
[list]
[*] Kirian Fields reworked visual map
[*] Added more explored areas to all maps
[*] Challenge Ancient Gates: A new area with reward respawns and a combat arena
[/list]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improvements to all menus
[*] Added more save slots ( Cloud save will be implemented soon! )
[*] VSync Video options
[/list]


[h1]Developer Note[/h1]
This new update made the game much more dynamic and similar to the final vision we have for it. I would like to thank everyone who helped with opinions, suggestions and guidance.

We still have a lot of work ahead of us and we intend to continue with the development, adding new maps and content.

We are currently working on improvements to controller inputs, new features and also new items that will be available soon. In addition, we are back with everything and we will finish the 3rd map with a new area to explore.

And don't forget that your opinion is extremely important to us here at Breaking Gates, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts with us at [url=https://discord.gg/S7cYURPDFA]discord.gg/breakinggates[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thanks for the support, we made a small update to correct some errors in the game that you reported and also some adjustments to the game's balance.

[h1] Corrections [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error opening the inventory menu when dead!
[*] Fixed resolution switching error when entering a room on the “Kirian Surroundings” map
[/list]

[h1] Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to open the menu by pressing [Esc], [Backspace] or [Enter]
[*] Adjusted HP of some enemies on the “Kirian Surroundings” map

[h3] Improvements in the boss's fight [/h3]
[*] Adjustments in the first boss "Gadus", we corrected some wrong behaviors that made him more difficult, for example: Sometimes right after a jump he would run away. On the other hand, we made some more unpredictable decisions. If you played and got there, please let us know what you think about the difficulty. Remembering that the fight with this boss is challenging so you need to be strong and have equipment of higher levels as well.

[h3] Stones that can be destroyed in the scenario [/h3]
[*] Ore stones now appear more often and are reset when the player returns to camp. This will make it easier to collect the resources to manufacture rarer grade equipment with Helga. We are working on a new equipment manufacturing system as the current system is very random.
[/list]


[h1] For new players, bug reports and suggestions [/h1]
We also updated the community forum here. If you happen to find something that is not working as it should, please read this topic and report what happened.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1248550/discussions/1/

notes.title: Patch Notes #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! How are you? I hope they're all great!

We would like to thank all the new players who have submitted their opinions and are helping us to make Breaking Gates even better.
We are currently working tirelessly on the next chapter of the game which will have another complete map in addition to new enemies and items. But for now it follows some changes and improvements Thanks for the support of all of you ^ - ^

[h3] Changes [/h3]
[list]
[*] Defeated enemies now don't reappear when exiting the rooms. Only when you return to camp.
[*] Adjustments on all enemies to improve the game's balance.
[*] Material items and wearable items now have different colors for easy identification.
[/list]
[h3] Interface [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the option to adjust the window size in the settings.
[*] Added smooth or sharp graphic filter; You can switch in the settings.
[/list]
[h3] Bug fixes [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error in the item description window not disappearing when exiting the inventory menu.
[*] Fixed collision errors that prevented the player from entering a new room on the first map.
[*] Fixed an error in the cursor that did not reach the "Missions" tabs in the inventory.
[*] Fixed an error that did not inform the player when completing a hunting challenge.
[*] Other minor bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.content:
Hello guys! We would like to thank you for all the support and suggestions you are giving to us. We are working on a new map that will be available soon, we will post more on our social networks. In the meantime, here are some changes and improvements that you have reported to us.

[*] Fixed error when receiving hunting mission prizes with full inventory.
[*] Fixed collision errors with the roof in some parts of the map.

[*] Other minor bugs fixed.
[/list]

[h3] Interface [/h3]
[list]
[*] Interface size and resolution have been improved.
[*] On the keyboard, you can now access the menu by pressing [Backspace] or [Enter].

notes.title: Minior Fixes Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Passing here to inform you of the update that is already available to everyone. Unfortunately we realized that the game was not working properly in some ways. So before proceeding with new content we decided to stop and go back.

The main change is that the game is now running at a better frame rate. We still have many improvements that we want to make in the interface and resolution, in addition to several others that were suggested by you, so I would like to thank you all for participating in this game. And wait, we are preparing a lot of cool news! (^ - ^)

[h3] Interface [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a small tutorial showing the controls on the controller or keyboard at the beginning of the game.
[*] For the keyboard, the skill commands are now [A S D].
[*] The [C] and [X] keys are now used to confirm and cancel the menus and not [Enter] anymore.
[/list]
[h3] Changes [/h3]
[list]
[*] Hunting and crafting missions are now renewed after completing 5 of them.
[*] Some enemies from the "Allira Forest" map have been moved.
[*] The poisonous plants on the walls can now be destroyed.
[/list]
[h3] Bug fixes [/ h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error that changed the character's max HP when starting the game;
[*] Equipment that did not count the Technical attribute is now functioning;
[*] Fixed the error of the special "Cutting wave" that pushed enemies fixed on the ground;
[/list]

If you want to help in development by reporting any bugs or suggestions, come and talk to us! We are working on the game all the time but we always get the time to respond and post news on our networks (@breakinggates)
